annotations.title: Detailed report of an unlocked car

description:
The detailed report of a car the user has unlocked on their RegTail account: verdict and top risks, every MOT test
    with defects and advisories, mileage analysis, recurring advisories, other sections,
    the viewing checklist, what was not checked, and guidance for explaining it. Use to discuss a car in depth. Needs
    the user's RegTail account linked. Never spends: for a plate that is not unlocked it returns unlocked=false and a
    message; then ask the user before calling unlock_report.
